name: zk-credential-revocation-system
description: Research prototype: ZK selective disclosure over W3C VCs with two benchmarkable revocation schemes (nullifier registry vs sparse-Merkle non-membership)

scripts.setup:circom: mkdir -p tools/bin && curl -sL -o tools/bin/circom https://github.com/iden3/circom/releases/download/v2.2.3/circom-linux-amd64 && chmod +x tools/bin/circom && tools/bin/circom --version
scripts.deploy:local: npm run deploy:local -w @zkcr/contracts && npm run sync:apps
